# DevDeskApp Documentation

> Official documentation for DevDeskApp (340+ browser-based developer tools at https://www.devdeskapp.com) and the `n8n-nodes-devdeskapp` n8n community node.
> Full context: https://docs.devdeskapp.com/llms-full.txt

`n8n-nodes-devdeskapp` (v0.1.6, MIT) adds one node, DevDeskApp, with 19 operations in 5 resources. Operations run synchronously inside the n8n process with no external API calls and need no credentials. The node declares `usableAsTool: true`, so it can be attached to an n8n AI Agent's Tool port.

## Core facts
- Web app: 340+ tools that process input in the browser.
- n8n node: 19 operations (JSON, Crypto, Text, Calculator, E-commerce). Each output item keeps `pairedItem`. Errors throw `NodeOperationError`, or return `{ "error": "..." }` when the node's On Error setting continues.
- Measured node logic for 10,000 items: CTC 12.6 ms, JSON prettify 22.6 ms, slugify 40.7 ms, SHA-256 46.5 ms.
- 7 templates published on n8n.io: #21017, #21130, #21376, #21593, #21594, #21595, #21596. #21593 to #21596 need a small fix after import, documented on each template page.

- [Template #21130: CTC Salary Engine](https://docs.devdeskapp.com/templates/ctc-salary-engine): Annual CTC to monthly in-hand breakdown.
- [Template #21376: Payment Webhook Sanitizer](https://docs.devdeskapp.com/templates/payment-webhook-sanitizer): Format, checksum and trace payment webhooks with Slack alerts.
- [Template #21593: AI LLM JSON Ingestion](https://docs.devdeskapp.com/templates/ai-llm-postgres-ingest): Strip markdown fences, format, hash and insert LLM JSON into PostgreSQL.
- [Template #21594: CTC Offer Letter Generator](https://docs.devdeskapp.com/templates/offer-letter-generator): Salary breakdown into Google Docs, Gmail and Slack.
- [Template #21595: Meta CAPI Lead Sync](https://docs.devdeskapp.com/templates/meta-capi-lead-sync): Lowercase and SHA-256 hash lead emails for the Meta Conversions API.
- [Template #21596: Notion to WordPress Publisher](https://docs.devdeskapp.com/templates/notion-wordpress-publisher): SEO slug, content hash and WordPress publishing.
- [How to Import Templates](https://docs.devdeskapp.com/templates/how-to-import): Copy a template and paste it onto the n8n canvas.
- [AI Agents & LLM Function Calling](https://docs.devdeskapp.com/solutions/ai-agents): Using the node as an AI Agent tool.
- [Local Node vs Cloud APIs](https://docs.devdeskapp.com/solutions/): Measured timings and trade-offs.
- [Production Best Practices](https://docs.devdeskapp.com/solutions/best-practices): Paired items, error handling, batches and hashing.
- [Architecture & Privacy](https://docs.devdeskapp.com/about/architecture): How the web app and the node handle data.

## Operations summary (resource.operation)
1. `json.prettify`: Format JSON with 2 spaces, 4 spaces or tabs. Output `formatted`.
2. `json.minify`: Remove whitespace. Output `minified`.
3. `json.validate`: Check JSON without throwing. Output `valid`, plus `parsed` or `error`.
4. `crypto.hash`: md5, sha1, sha256 or sha512 hex digest. Output `algorithm`, `input`, `hash`.
5. `crypto.base64Encode`: UTF-8 text to Base64. Output `encoded`.
6. `crypto.base64Decode`: Base64 to UTF-8 text. Output `decoded`.
7. `crypto.uuid`: Random UUID v4. Output `uuid`, `version`.
8. `text.slugify`: URL slug. Output `slug`.
9. `text.caseConverter`: camelCase, kebabCase, lowerCase, pascalCase, snakeCase or upperCase. Output `original`, `casing`, `result`.
10. `text.urlEncode`: Percent-encode text. Output `encoded`.
11. `text.urlDecode`: Decode percent-encoding. Output `decoded`.
12. `calculator.ctcToInHand`: Indian annual CTC to monthly gross, basic, PF (12% of basic, capped at ₹1,800), PT ₹200, new-regime TDS estimate and in-hand pay.
13. `ecommerce.catalogMapper`: Map product catalogs between Shopify, WooCommerce and Google Merchant Center.
14. `ecommerce.upiQr`: Build a UPI payment URI and QR payload.
15. `ecommerce.gstJsonToTable`: Flatten GSTR-1, GSTR-3B or GSTR-2B JSON into rows.
16. `ecommerce.profitCalculator`: Profit margin and ROAS after fees, shipping, ads and RTO.
17. `ecommerce.shippingLabelCrop`: Crop coordinates for carrier shipping labels.
18. `ecommerce.webhookVerifier`: Verify Razorpay, Shopify, Stripe or custom HMAC-SHA256 webhook signatures.
19. `ecommerce.whatsappPayload`: Build WhatsApp interactive message payloads.
